seoul-south-korea-danyang-river-and-pass.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Treat High point near Ansan-si → Near Bucheon-si as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Scenic stretch near Goyang-si → Photo stop in Beobwon is the reward section in Seoul. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.to: Near Yangp'yŏng, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop in Beobwon → Near Yangp'yŏng, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

sections.from: Near Yangp'yŏng, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop near Yangp'yŏng → Back to Danyang River is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
A line-crossing or merge area where relaxed sightseeing traffic can behave unpredictably.
Watch shade, leaves, gravel wash and damp patches; conditions decide the pace.
Viewpoints and car parks can create sudden stops in otherwise flowing terrain.

places-la-saltadora-abric-i-abrigo-del-a.story: A 186 km round trip from Albocàsser - roughly 3 h 12 in the saddle. The stops in between: Cova Remigia- Abric l, Barranco de Gibert II, Abrigo del Arenal de la fonseca ó Abrigo d and back through Barranco de Gibert II. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
